name: boxed-messages
description: Boxed chat messages for Claude Code: a colored bar and optional tinted background on your prompts (blue) and Claude's replies (orange), plus a built-in status line

showBars.title: Message bars
showBars.description: Colored bar left of your prompts (blue) and Claude's replies (orange)

showBackground.title: Message background
showBackground.description: Tint behind each message, a lighter version of its bar color

backgroundShade.title: Background shade
backgroundShade.description: dark: dim tint for dark terminal themes. light: pastel tint for light terminal themes

showStatusLine.title: Status line
showStatusLine.description: Built-in status line under the prompt: model, effort, context, git branch, usage and reset timers. Replaces any other statusLine while on
